meta.actionKo: 가래를 묽게 하여 배출을 쉽게 하는 점액용해 거담제입니다.
meta.actionEn: A mucolytic expectorant that thins phlegm and makes it easier to cough up.

en.19dfa642: This medicine is used for difficulty expelling phlegm in the diseases of acute and chronic bronchitis, bronchial asthma, laryngitis, sinusitis, and cystic fibrosis.
en.498572bf: This medicine is used for difficulty expelling phlegm in acute and chronic bronchitis, bronchial asthma, laryngitis, sinusitis, and cystic fibrosis.
en.4ea2258f: For acute conditions, adults usually take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 3 times a day, and children 6 to 14 years old take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 2 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.803068f8: For acute conditions, adults take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 3 times a day, and children 6 to 14 years old take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 2 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.514ea400: For chronic conditions, adults usually take 2 capsules (200 mg) per dose, 2 times a day, and children 6 to 14 years old take 1 capsule (100 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.cb9e0227: For chronic conditions, adults take 2 capsules (200 mg) per dose, 2 times a day, and children 6 to 14 years old take 1 capsule (100 mg) per dose, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.8f12d233: For cystic fibrosis, people 6 years and older take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.e4972b72: For cystic fibrosis, people 6 years and older take 2 capsules (200 mg) per 1 dose, 3 times a day, before meals with a small amount of water.
en.6d58e027: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, have gastric or duodenal ulcers, are an infant under 2 years old, or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.ec90c404: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, have gastric or duodenal ulcers, or are an infant under 2 years old.
en.64bbe172: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
en.1b9e3b15: When taking this medicine with oral antibiotics (amoxicillin, cefuroxime, doxycycline, erythromycin, thiamphenicol), take them at least 2 hours apart.
en.df841609: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine together with oral antibiotics (amoxicillin, cefuroxime, doxycycline, erythromycin, thiamphenicol), other antibiotics, tetracycline, erythromycin, or bromhexine.
en.a7e59321: Avoid adding other medicines to a solution of this medicine.
en.2741da30: In rare cases, if nausea, vomiting, mouth sores (stomatitis), heartburn, diarrhea, hives, itching, rash, headache, ringing in the ears, bronchospasm (especially in asthma patients), rapid pulse, high blood pressure, difficulty breathing, or rarely anaphylaxis occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
